title: Regroup sentences without changing a word
summary: Organize twelve supplied sentences under useful headings while preserving every sentence and punctuation mark exactly.
originNote: A standard organization task carrying a history-derived lossless transformation boundary and explicit repair turn.

setup.instructions: Mount the source fixture read-only. Run every turn in order in one fresh workspace. The model must create and revise only grouped.md.

turns.content: Read `source-sentences.md`. Create `grouped.md` by placing every sentence under exactly one of these headings: Place, Work, or Unresolved. Preserve every sentence's words and punctuation exactly. You may reorder whole sentences, but may not add, delete, merge, split, or rewrite them. Add no commentary beyond the three headings.
Audit `grouped.md` against `source-sentences.md` token for token. Repair any changed, missing, duplicated, merged, or added sentence. Keep the three headings and no other prose.

checks.description: Each of the twelve source sentences appears exactly once and unchanged under one of the three required headings.
